name: refine-frame
title: Refine Frame
description: A rounded image frame that moves through queued, generating, refining and ready states, resolving a low-resolution mosaic into the sharp photo without shifting layout.
use: An AI image tool needs one result frame that shows queued, generating and ready without layout shift.
avoid: It only styles your child image and a chip; real job status and polling must come from your own code.
a11y: Role, busy state and status text are announced, but the retry button has no visible focus ring. (keyboard: partial, labels: good, reduced motion: respected)
looks: A rounded rectangle holding a landscape photo, with a small translucent pill in the bottom-left corner showing a spinner icon and a status word. Above it sits a quoted prompt line in grey, below a small outlined Regenerate button.
behaves: When the status changes the picture steps from a coarse pixel mosaic toward full sharpness under a moving sheen while the corner chip swaps icons and labels. At ready the chip shows a tick and then fades out.
customise: Status, aspect ratio, width, radius, background and text colour are props, as are stage duration, sweep, labels and retry; the child image is yours.
weight: moderate: A stack of downscaled canvas copies is rebuilt on resize and drawn per frame while active.
demo: Prompt 'Alpine lake at dawn, mist over the water, soft film grain' with a mountain photo.
issues: The frame's role='img' hides the child photo's alt text from screen readers.
polishWhy: The mosaic-to-sharp resolve is convincing and layout stays put; small chips stay unobtrusive.
